scientific_integrity.computational_evidence: 45 exact rational inverse network checks, Fourier checks and independent scalar threshold diagnostics; standard-library code embedded.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Grounded electrical Green kernel, exact nonconstant Fourier eigenvalues of squared resistance, one-dimensional radial Schur complement, monotonicity and Riemann-sum limit.

scientific_limitations: All rim conductances equal one, all spoke conductances equal the same strictly positive parameter.
The exact supremal negative-type exponent away from the critical conductance is not calculated; only its position relative to two is determined.
Finite program checks support but do not replace the analytic all-order Fourier and monotonicity proofs.
An unindexed or otherwise unseen equivalent embedding classification remains a publication-priority risk.
title: A sharp Euclidean spoke threshold and inverse-square scaling for electrical wheel metrics
